events.name: Guided Full Venue History Tour (60 Minutes)
events.info: Guided, full venue tour of Antone's. Tour includes a deep dive into Antone's history through its six locations exploring how the club became known internationally as Austin's Home of the Blues. Attendees get a special, behind the scenes screening of never-before-seen performances at Antone's Nightclub. Drinks available for purchase. Check-in: 1:45pm at Big Henry's. Tour begins promptly at 2pm.
events.pleaseNote: Please Note: SEATING Your Antones ticket grants you General Admission entry with standing room. Limited seating may be available on a first-come, first-served basis, but is subject to change show to show. If you have an ADA request, please reach out and we will do our best to accommodate you. PARKING We recommend booking convenient and affordable downtown parking in advance through SpotHero. For street parking, please check posted signs and pay stations for enforcement information. Valet parking is available for purchase at The Westin Hotel, across the street from Antone?s, at 310 E 5th Street. FOOD Antone's proudly serves beer-steamed Cliffy Dog hotdogs and Antone's Famous Po Boys in five classic varieties: Original, Turkey & Swiss, Premium Roast Beef, Tuna, and The Piggy. These iconic sandwiches, created by Clifford's uncle Jalal in 1962, are available with Zapp's New Orleans Kettle Style Potato Chips.

venues.name: Scoot Inn

boxOfficeInfo.openHoursDetail: The Scoot Inn box office opens at doors on day of show
boxOfficeInfo.acceptedPaymentDetail: This is a cashless venue inside. We accept all major credit cards including VISA, Mastercard, Amex, & Discover. Apple Pay and Google Play are also accepted.

venues.parkingDetail: o PARKING: Parking is located at 501 Navasota St. (on the corner of 5th and Navasota), one block north of Scoot Inn. PURCHASING OPTIONS: You may purchase online as an Add-On when you're buying your tickets in Checkout or in the separate parking link for each show. Click here to reserve your parking in advance. You may also park in the garage and then purchase validation for at the Box Office. PARKING INSTRUCTIONS: If you bought a parking ticket online in advance, park in the garage and go to the Box Office to receive your parking validation. Tickets are also available for purchase at the Box Office. Park in the garage and go to the Box Office to pay for your parking validation. NOTE: As you leave the garage, scan your physical parking ticket FIRST and your parking validation second! STREET PARKING AND RIDE SHARE: Pay-to-park street parking is extremely limited. Ride-shares to Scoot Inn are highly encouraged. Drop off is located on the West side of the Box Office (closest to IH-35) on 4th Street.
venues.accessibleSeatingDetail: At Scoot Inn, we strive to make our venue and live experiences inclusive and accessible to all. The main entrance to Scoot Inn is accessible. Restrooms located on the north side of the main building have ADA-accessible stalls. Anyone needing prescription medicine must present the pharmacy-labeled container which states the prescription, dosage, and patient name to our medical staff at each entrance gate. For more accessibility information please visit https://www.scootinnaustin.com/accessibility or you can reach us at scootinnaustin@livenation.com , or by phone at 512.777.0873.

generalInfo.generalRule: Please be respectful of our neighborhood. For more information on our venue policies and FAQ, please visit our website https://www.scootinnaustin.com/
generalInfo.childRule: Age requirements differ depending on the event. All age requirements are listed on our online event calendar. If no age restriction is listed, the event is all ages.

venues.parkingDetail: We highly encourage rideshare. Drop off is in front of the security screening lanes. If you do drive, please carefully review signage. Please park on the streets where able. Emos is not responsible if your vehicle is booted or towed. AutoZone, Club Carnaval, and Taco More lots are actively booting.
venues.accessibleSeatingDetail: At Emos, we strive to make our venue and live experiences inclusive and accessible to all. The main entrance to Emos is fully accessible. Please be advised that this is done on a first come, first serve basis and our accessible seating area can reach capacity early. All bathrooms within the venue are equipped with ADA accessible stalls. ADA parking is first come, first serve and is located in front of the venue main entrance near our security checkpoint. Anyone needing prescription medicine must present the pharmacy labeled container which states the prescription, dosage, and patient name to our medical staff at each entrance gate.
